observations: Photo 0 shows 20 PlayStation game cases stacked in two columns on a glass surface.
The left column contains 9 PS5 games: two copies of FC 25, Spider-Man Miles Morales, Ghostwire Tokyo, Elden Ring, God of War Ragnarok, Call of Duty Black Ops Cold War, FC 24, and WWE 2K22.
The right column contains 6 PS4 games: Spider-Man, Call of Duty Black Ops Cold War, Outriders, Mortal Kombat 11 Ultimate, Call of Duty Vanguard, and Grand Theft Auto V.
The right column also contains 5 PS5 games: Uncharted Legacy of Thieves Collection, Hogwarts Legacy, Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty, Gran Turismo 7, and Godfall.
The 'PS4' and 'PS5' branding is clearly visible on the top of each case spine.
No factory shrink-wrap is visible on any of the cases shown.
The background suggests a retail or shop environment.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a mix of PS4 and PS5 games; the majority (14 of 20) are PS5 titles.
None of the games in photo 0 are shown in original factory seals.
The PlayStation 6 has not been released; the photo shows PS4 and PS5 games.

risks.proof: Photo of the open cases showing the actual discs inside.
Video of the discs being inserted into a console and the games loading to the main menu.
Photo of the games (specifically the high-value FC 25) next to a handwritten note with the current date and buyer's name.

proof_requests: Photo of the discs inside the cases, especially for FC 25 and Elden Ring.
Photo of the games with a handwritten note showing today's date and your name to prove physical possession.
Clarification on the 'Ps6' claim as that console does not exist.
response.reason: The seller claims the items are for a 'Ps6', which is a non-existent console. This, combined with the discrepancy between the text description (PS4) and the photo (mostly PS5) and the offer of 'nationwide delivery', are strong indicators of a fraudulent listing.
